_comment: Probe config for company_017_meta (Facebook, founded per S-1 'incorporated in Delaware in July 2004'). Authored by probe-meta 2026-09-26; mirrors the verified task shapes in tools/queries.json (Walmart exemplars). Windows: 2004-2006 = college-source/press period; 2004-2013 = corporate-print period. Run: python tools/periodical_harvest.py --config <this file> --company meta --out <company>/sources/_harvest

per_source_caps._note: Caps >= task counts on purpose (see tools/queries.json per_source_caps note: a cap below the task count writes UNANSWERED rows for tasks never attempted).
